steps.goal: Determine whether the visible STOP platform is the ferry brake needed to open a route.

unknowns: No player inputs were recorded, so all actions above are hypotheses and observed_feedback remains null.
Whether STOP is a pad, whether the ferry moves, and what action applies a brake are not demonstrated.
The status names a glucose condition, but the required source of glucose and its relationship to the visible spark or gate are unknown.
The function of PAC RESCUE STAYS ON, the barriers, and the visible danger below the platforms is not demonstrated.
The mandatory both-exit route, safe waiting places, failure consequence, retry and recovery behavior, and active timing windows are unknown.
Idle inspection cannot establish control reliability or shared-keyboard friction.
